purpose: Bridge the existing PRE interface, feature registry, market snapshots, and strict temporal evaluator without admitting any protected or unauthorized source.

line_structure.allowed: PRE line snapshot satisfying existing PRE_INTERFACE_SCHEMA_DRAFT_v1
line_structure.missing_or_unknown: line-dependent candidate abstains/fails closed; non-line baselines may remain eligible if their own inputs are valid

result_boundary.observed_outcome: may enter evaluator only as label after feature object and prediction object are frozen

minimum_machine_checks: decision_timestamp <= race start cutoff defined by rule id
raw provenance SHA present for each admitted source object
same race cannot appear twice in one evaluation manifest
same event split contamination detected before scoring
next_gate: Create toy fixtures and adapter tests only. Real source binding requires a separate source-availability and rights/provenance record.
